tasks.label: SovereignShield: correct compute policy types
tasks.command:
Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Force
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$env:DATABRICKS_HOST = 'https://adb-7405613190562799.19.azuredatabricks.net'
$env:DATABRICKS_AUTH_TYPE = 'azure-cli'
Remove-Item Env:ARM_CLIENT_ID,Env:ARM_CLIENT_SECRET,Env:DATABRICKS_ACCOUNT_ID -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Import-Module .\sh\lib\SovereignShield.Orchestration.psm1 -Force
Invoke-SovereignShieldTerraformApply -Terraform (Get-SovereignShieldTerraform) -RepoRoot $PWD.Path -VarFile terraform.tfvars -Variables @('account_groups_ready=true','grant_tables=false','deploy_dissemination_gateway=false')

tasks.label: SovereignShield: repair ingestion and verify runtime
tasks.command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$env:DATABRICKS_HOST = 'https://adb-7405613190562799.19.azuredatabricks.net'
$env:DATABRICKS_AUTH_TYPE = 'azure-cli'
Remove-Item Env:ARM_CLIENT_ID,Env:ARM_CLIENT_SECRET,Env:DATABRICKS_ACCOUNT_ID,Env:BUNDLE_VAR_ingestion_cluster -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
databricks bundle deploy -t dev
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Bundle repair deployment failed.' }
databricks jobs repair-run --json '{"run_id":504168656605624,"rerun_tasks":["run_scd2_merge","verify_synthetic_runtime"]}'
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Ingestion repair failed.' }

tasks.label: SovereignShield: rebuild verified gateway image
SovereignShield: monitor repaired runtime acceptance
tasks.command:
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe sh/wait_databricks_run.py --host https://adb-7405613190562799.19.azuredatabricks.net --run-id 504168656605624 --minutes 25
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Repaired runtime acceptance did not succeed.' }
